notes: Listing projects, deployments, env vars (non-secret), and logs
runs automatically. Creating a preview deployment or updating env
vars is write-tier — confirm before the first write. Promoting a
deployment to production is modify-tier because it is the
single-step path to a live production change; always require
explicit confirmation and surface the deployment URL, commit
hash, and alias. Deleting a deployment, deleting an env var, or
rolling back production is destructive-tier — strong explicit
confirmation. Unlisted actions are bumped one tier above the
conservative default per the design doc §6.
